title: mine evidence to extend IN_STATES for India
headline: IN_STATES needs no extension for India. All 28 states and 9 UT/NCT codes are already keys (37 distinct values, 86 effective keys); three independent mining sweeps over the visible India address vocabulary return ZERO unhandled state-shaped token above the 1,979-occurrence truncation floor. The one NEW defect found is NOT in IN_STATES: LEET['@'] and LEET['$'] at normalize.py:256 are structurally unreachable dead entries.
new_defect: LEET['@'] and LEET['$'] (normalize.py:256) can never fire: _non_alnum = [^a-z0-9]+ (normalize.py:269) splits them away before the translate at normalize.py:280. Severity cosmetic. Correct fix is a pre-split substitution at normalize.py:273, not a larger LEET table.

denominators.source: sum(country_rows['India']) over train_s1..3,test_s1..3; cross-checked against sum(by_country['India']['rows'])
denominators.reason_lower_bound: build_profile.py:27 TOPN=4000 caps each per-file list; build_profile.py:45-48 also prunes count<=1 every 8 chunks
denominators.note: Every India rate in this report uses the six-file sum as denominator. No single-source rate is quoted.

in_states_structure.completeness: all 28 Indian states and all 9 UT/NCT codes are present. No state-level addition is possible.

truncation_floor.interpretation: a token absent from all six lists has a true six-file total < 1979. 'measured 0' means below an unstated threshold, not absent.

multiword_keys_14.note: structurally impossible; they contain a space. Their 0 is NOT a measurement.

measurability_partition_of_86_effective_.grain_note: differs from D078's '36 of 86 below the floor'; D078 counted a different grain. Mine = 28 directly-measured zeros + 14 structurally unmeasurable.

measured_mass_already_captured.IMPORTANT: UPPER BOUNDS on state matches, not match counts. addr_tokens is a unigram bag with no component structure; normalize.py:333 requires the WHOLE comma-component to equal the key.

sweeps_run.name: gazetteer
sweeps_run.result: every Indian state/UT name is already a key or measures 0
sweeps_run.status: negative result at resolution limit, not proof of zero

sweeps_run.name: fuzzy (cutoff 0.85, count>=2000, unhandled only)
sweeps_run.note: demonyms and city fragments, not state variants

sweeps_run.name: geography-suffix (167 tokens ending pur/pradesh/garh/nagar/bad/gram/circle/zone/region/taluk/mandi/district/block/ward/sector, count>=1500)
sweeps_run.result: overwhelmingly cities and localities; NOT ONE is a state. Adding them would be actively wrong.

leet_findings.proof: normalize.py:269 _non_alnum=[^a-z0-9]+ guarantees tokens matching ^[a-z0-9]+$ only; verified by executing a byte-exact replica of _name_tokens over aXc for all ASCII alphanumeric X: zero tokens containing @ or $
leet_findings.recommendation: do NOT add 2/9 to LEET and do NOT apply LEET to addresses. b3 (105589) would become bg.

component_structure.conclusion: the state-lookup precondition (>=2 comma components) is effectively universal for India. This is the OPPOSITE of the France s2/s3 situation.

india_pin_finding.finding: the India pin signal is effectively dead. 93.79% of India addresses contain digits yet only 2237 standalone 6-digit numbers exist in 10,544,085 rows.
india_pin_finding.inference_marked: the digits present are house/floor/plot/sector numbers, not 6-digit PIN codes
india_pin_finding.not_claimed: NOT claiming the len==6 guard is wrong for India; claiming it has almost nothing to capture either way

confirms_as_non_defect.why_safe: normalize.py:333-335 runs the state lookup and `continue`s, so the component never reaches the canon loop at normalize.py:342-349. Both routes land on the same canonical value.

d078_refinement.claim: 'jammu & kashmir' (normalize.py:239) is unreachable because normalize.py:331 replaces & with ' and ' before the lookup
d078_refinement.severity_correction: NET USER-FACING LOSS IS ZERO. The twin key 'jammu and kashmir' is on the same line and DOES match the transformed input 'Jammu & Kashmir' -> ck='jammu and kashmir' -> jk.

india_district_finding.recommendation: belongs in a district/city table or a city feature, NEVER in IN_STATES
india_district_finding.why_not: no co-occurrence data; cannot show a district-bearing address also carries its state. The France department gap cannot be assumed to transfer to India.

abbreviation_collision_risk.verdict: quantified and dismissed. normalize.py:333 needs the WHOLE component to equal the key, so the reachable set is a strict subset of 6390.

bears_on_already_checked.REFUTED-1: NOT supported. My France dig5/row: test_s1 0.0042, test_s2 0.0051, test_s3 0.0053, vs US 0.1097-0.1101 and India 0.0028-0.0114. Matches the work order's quoted 0.004/0.005. REFUTED-1 STANDS AS REFUTED.
bears_on_already_checked.REFUTED-2: Out of scope, untouched. I quote no French resolution rate and do NOT reconcile the 71.10% vs 97.4380% contradiction. One cross-cutting note: India's component structure is near-perfect (4 exceptions in 10.5M rows), so the France s2/s3 problem is a VOCABULARY problem, not a component-splitting problem.

gaps: No component structure in the profile => no state-resolution rate is derivable. Every state-key count is an upper bound. This is the single largest limitation.
42 of 86 effective keys unmeasurable (10 codes + 18 names below floor, 14 multiword structurally unmeasurable). Not estimated.
No co-occurrence data => the district finding cannot be upgraded to a defect claim.
Semicolon prevalence unmeasurable; has_comma records ',' only. D078 Defect H remains open and is the one mechanism that could break the 4-exception component result.

Indic script is invisible: TOKEN_RE=[a-z0-9]+ and translit_text is not applied by the profile builder. Indic-script addresses contribute zero tokens; all counts biased downward by an unquantified amount.
Truncation is two-edged: counts are lower bounds AND the prune(count<=1) runs periodically, so the true floor is above 1979.

recommendations.action: DO NOT add anything to IN_STATES for India
recommendations.expected_effect: zero gain, and any edit enlarges the D079 collision surface

recommendations.action: Delete LEET['@'] and LEET['$'], or implement the intent as a pre-split replacement at normalize.py:273
recommendations.expected_effect: cosmetic; removes a misleading dead table entry; zero behavioural risk

recommendations.action: Record the India district vocabulary as an owned follow-up for a district/city table, NOT IN_STATES; close the component-structure profile gap first
recommendations.expected_effect: unquantified; do not size this fix from this report

recommendations.action: Do NOT extend LEET with 2/9 and do NOT apply LEET to addresses
recommendations.expected_effect: net-negative; would endanger 859099 occurrences of address token '2' and corrupt b3 -> bg

recommendations.action: NO CHANGE to the len>3 guard in learn_translit.py
recommendations.expected_effect: 41 of 86 keys stay unreachable; out of scope, flagged only

recommendations.action: NO CHANGE to or->od / ut->uk, and no removal of the dead 'jammu & kashmir' key
recommendations.expected_effect: churn only; both measure 0 Indian occurrences and the & twin covers the input

recommendations.action: Add a whole-component histogram to build_profile.py
recommendations.expected_effect: highest-leverage item; currently every 'does X resolve' question in the project is unanswerable
